commit_sha_convention: Points to the immediately preceding P2A-2F0 handoff commit; this metadata update avoids a self-referential commit loop.
actual_changes: Read-only schema gap check completed for image-level Vision observations.
schema_gap: No current table binds an image-level observation or inference to image_asset, source-content SHA-256, observer/model identity, and analysis-definition version.
Current reference-level observation, assessment, and promotional tables cannot preserve multiple image analyses and later human corrections without semantic overloading or destructive replacement.
existing_structures_reused: image_asset for stable identity and image_hash exact-content SHA-256 (migrations/006_p1c_image_assets.sql).
design_reference_image for asset/reference linkage and image_role (migrations/006_p1c_image_assets.sql).
design_reference_observation for later reference-level synthesis and confirmed material linkage (migrations/001_initial.sql).
image_perceptual_hash as the content-SHA plus algorithm-version precedent (migrations/007_p2a_perceptual_hash.sql).

constraints: Source SHA must be 64 hexadecimal characters and match image_asset.image_hash at insertion.
AI cannot write confirmed facts; human/source confirmation remains a separate evidence-backed canonical step.
Corrections are new append-only rows linked by supersedes_observation_id; original AI output is retained.
Use an idempotency key covering asset, source SHA, analysis version, producer, class, type and value.

important_semantic_boundaries: Visible evidence is observation; appearance-based interpretation is inference; confirmed fact requires separate user/source/supplier evidence.
Image-level observation is separate from reference-level synthesis.
Product-design observation is separate from promotional visual observation.
evidence_pointers: migrations/006_p1c_image_assets.sql: image_asset, design_reference_image, provider identity index, image_hash
docs/schema.md: semantic separation and image asset/pHash rules
risks_or_blockers: Reusing reference-level tables would lose image/content-state traceability.
A fixed column for every visual attribute would create premature schema coupling.
requires_gpt_decision: Approve or revise the one-table append-only proposal, initial observation_type vocabulary, analysis_version convention, and SHA equality enforcement mechanism.
tests_or_checks: Read-only inspection of the four relevant migrations, docs/schema.md, field-review provenance structures, and scripts/crystal-db.mjs examples.
next_minimum_action: Wait for GPT approval; then draft only a minimal migration and tests. Do not run Vision or proceed to migration 008 in P2A-2F0.
